description: Inventory of all production closed loops is maintained in one place.
Every closed loop uses an explicit decision model (OODA, MAPE, or custom).
Every loop has a measurable goal with target + direction + owner.
Loops are managed via an explicit state machine.
Feedback and feedforward paths are modeled as separate workflows.
Loops emit metrics (goal, current, drift, transitions) to a backend.
Loops are activated/deactivated through a managed control plane.
Logs, metrics, traces are unified across loops.
